description_en: Updates the nodes and dependencies of a workflow. This operation is available only in the Enterprise Edition
description_zh: 更新工作流的节点及依赖关系，专业版应用才支持
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 update-workflow-dag --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --workflow-id 123 --dag-json '{"nodes":[{"id":2300691},{"id":10518089},{"id":1758851}],"edges":[{"source":10518089,"target":1758851},{"source":10518089,"target":2300691}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkflowDag

parameters.help_en: The Namespace ID. You can obtain the ID on the Namespaces page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for specific third-party integrations
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The Application Group ID. You can find this ID on the Application Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The definition of the workflow's directed acyclic graph (DAG), including nodes and edges, as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 工作流DAG信息，包括了Node和Edge的信息，json格式
parameters.name: dag_json
